_comment: Same as two_channel_arming_check_600.json, except arm_duration_ms is raised to push run_scenario.py's total arm timeout (arm_duration_ms + ARM_TIMEOUT_MARGIN_MS, currently 8000) out to 20s instead of 10s - same technique two_channel_bidir_one_idle_600_long_arm.json already uses for BUG-002's R8. Exists to answer: when the gate times out at 10s with a motor mid-reboot-cycle (see 'Results: 10-run arming-reliability sample'), does it eventually arm given more room, or does that ESC keep rebooting indefinitely? Each AM32 reboot cycle costs ~2.4-2.6s, so 20s total covers roughly 6-7 cycles before the final 2s settle span - well past the worst case (4 reboots) seen so far.
